title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في الملتقى الدولي لرؤساء أقسام العربية في الجامعات الإفريقية بمكة
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the International Forum for Heads of Arabic Departments in African Universities, in Mecca
body_ar: يشارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين في فعاليات ملتقى علمي دولي تحتضنه مكة المكرمة، بوصفه ممثلا لجامعة ابن ياسين؛ حيث يستضيف المؤتمر رؤساء أقسام اللغة العربية في الجامعات الإفريقية. وتنظم جامعة أم القرى بمكة المكرمة هذا الملتقى الأول من نوعه، في الفترة ما بين السبت الماضي 10 ربيع الثاني 1433هـ الموافق 03 مارس 2012 إلى غاية 19 ربيع الثاني الموافق 12 مارس الجاري. وتميز هذا المتلقى العلمي بمحاضرة فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو في ندوة علمية أقيمت مساء الأحد الماضي 11 ربيع الثاني الموافق: 04 مارس الجاري، وكانت تحت عنوان: "أثر الاستعمار في تغريب اللسان الإفريقي وقطعه عن منابع الثقافة الإسلامية". ونشير إلى أن الملتقى يستمر لمدة أربعة أيام يتضمن برنامجاً علمياً يشمل الجلسات العلمية والندوات وورش العمل، ثم يليه البرنامج التدريبي الذي يستمر خمسة أيام متتالية تختتم بالجلسة الختامية والتوصيات.
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University, is taking part in the proceedings of an international scholarly forum hosted by Mecca the Ennobled, in his capacity as the representative of Ibn Yasin University; the conference hosts the heads of Arabic language departments in African universities. Umm al-Qura University in Mecca the Ennobled is organising this forum, the first of its kind, in the period from last Saturday, 10 Rabi' al-Thani 1433 AH, corresponding to 3 March 2012, up to 19 Rabi' al-Thani, corresponding to 12 March of the present month.

This scholarly forum was distinguished by the lecture of Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew at a scholarly symposium held on the evening of last Sunday, 11 Rabi' al-Thani, corresponding to 4 March of the present month, under the title "The Effect of Colonialism in Westernising the African Tongue and Cutting It Off from the Wellsprings of Islamic Culture".

We note that the forum runs for four days and comprises a scholarly programme taking in the academic sessions, the symposia and the workshops, and is then followed by the training programme, which runs for five consecutive days and concludes with the closing session and the recommendations.

flags.note: The record gives the title of the lecture and not one word of its content. A reader may reasonably infer the thesis from the title, but the corpus has no text for it: nothing of the argument, its evidence or its qualifications exists here. تغريب is rendered 'Westernising' rather than 'alienating' — both are live senses of the root, and the pairing with 'cutting it off from the wellsprings of Islamic culture' supports the former; recorded here because the lecture title will be quoted.

translator_notes: A news-desk announcement. It reports the Sheikh's participation and the title of one lecture, and carries none of his words.
The CMS timestamp, 10 March 2012, is a bulk-upload date. The body's internal dates are consistent with March 2012.

The Sheikh is styled 'president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University' here and 'president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars' in records 784, 785 and 789 of this same slice. Both offices are his; the variation is the source's.
